commit.message:
feat: approved minor onboarding via claim link (#244)

* feat: add verified_minor flag and create-minor-account endpoint

Add approved minor onboarding: migration adds verified_minor column,
new service-token endpoint creates account + claim link, status
endpoints return verified_minor flag via single combined query.

* fix: make create-minor-account idempotent for retry safety

On duplicate username, check if the existing account is an unclaimed
approved-minor (verified_minor=true, no email/password). If so, return
or create a valid claim token instead of 409 Conflict. Normal users,
claimed accounts, and unrelated duplicates still conflict.

* fix: address review feedback — tests, query collapse, 201/200, docs

- Collapse two-query idempotency check into single
  find_user_minor_status_by_username (eliminates TOCTOU gap)
- Use create_with_prior_invalidation for retry token creation
- Return 201 Created for new accounts, 200 OK for idempotent retries
- Add Deserialize to CreateMinorAccountResponse for test parsing
- Document APP_URL env var in CLAUDE.md
- Add 8 integration tests: happy path, idempotent retry, conflict
  (non-minor), conflict (claimed minor), invalid username, missing
  token, wrong token, retry with expired token

* fix: handle race condition on concurrent creates + add Vine conflict test

Catch RepositoryError::Duplicate from create_minor_account INSERT and
fall through to idempotent retry path instead of returning a confusing
400. Add integration test for Vine preloaded user (unclaimed non-minor)
returning 409 Conflict.

* fix: use claim_token.token consistently, add is_unclaimed doc comment

Use the DB-returned token value in the happy-path claim URL for
consistency with the idempotent retry paths. Add doc comment noting
that is_unclaimed logic must stay in sync with the claim flow.

commit.message:
feat: add batch-lookup endpoint for HubSpot contact enrichment (#245)

* docs: add design spec and plan for HubSpot batch-lookup endpoint

* feat: add POST /api/admin/users/batch-lookup for HubSpot enrichment

Service-token authenticated endpoint that accepts up to 1000 emails
and returns user data (pubkey, status, email_verified, has_personal_key,
created_at) for HubSpot contact enrichment via divine-invite-sync.

Server-side email dedup and case-insensitive matching. Uses existing
(tenant_id, email) index for efficient batch queries.

* test: add 11 integration tests for batch-lookup endpoint
